description: Create a centralized metricTooltips object mapping each metric key to a plain-English explanation covering: what it measures, how it's computed (brief), value range, and what high/low values mean for CA behavior
steps: A metricTooltips object exists in the JS with keys for all 10 metrics: entropy, density, meanField, wolframClass, symmetry, lyapunov, compressibility, period, entropyRate, excessEntropy
Each tooltip is 1-3 sentences long, written for a curious non-expert audience
Entropy tooltip explains Shannon entropy of cell states and that high=disordered, low=uniform
Density tooltip explains fraction of alive cells
Mean Field tooltip explains time-averaged density across all generations
Wolfram Class tooltip explains the 4-class behavioral classification (I=uniform, II=periodic, III=chaotic, IV=complex)
Symmetry tooltip explains left-right mirror symmetry of the spacetime grid
Lyapunov Exponent tooltip explains sensitivity to initial conditions and that positive=chaotic
Compressibility tooltip explains run-length encoding ratio and that high=simple patterns
Period tooltip explains temporal repetition and what aperiodic means
Entropy Rate (h) tooltip explains bits of new information per cell per time step
Excess Entropy (E) tooltip explains total stored information / structural complexity beyond randomness

description: Add a pure-CSS tooltip component that appears on hover over metric labels, styled to match the dark theme (#1a1a1a background, #00ff88 accent, light text)
steps: A .has-tooltip CSS class can be applied to any element to enable tooltip behavior
Tooltip text is stored in a data-tooltip attribute on the element
On hover, a tooltip box appears near the element with the explanation text
Tooltip has dark background (#222 or #1a1a1a), light text (#ccc), subtle green border, and rounded corners
Tooltip has a small arrow/caret pointing to the source element
Tooltip does not overflow the viewport — it repositions or constrains to stay visible
Tooltip has a slight delay before appearing (200-300ms) to avoid flickering on casual mouse movement
Tooltip disappears when the mouse leaves the element
Tooltip text wraps nicely at around 250-300px max width
Tooltip works on both the metric-label spans and table td elements

description: Add tooltip data attributes to metric labels in the formatMetricsHTML function so hovering over a metric name on any rule card shows its explanation
steps: Each metric-label span in the card (Entropy, Density, Symmetry, Period, h, E) has a data-tooltip attribute with the corresponding explanation
Each metric-label span has the has-tooltip CSS class applied
Hovering over 'Entropy:' on any rule card shows the entropy explanation tooltip
Hovering over 'h:' on a card shows the entropy rate explanation
Hovering over 'E:' shows the excess entropy explanation
The Wolfram Class badge also has a tooltip explaining the classification system
Tooltips do not interfere with clicking the card to open the modal
Tooltips work correctly on all 256 cards without performance issues

description: Add tooltip data attributes to the metric name cells in the modal detail view's metrics table so hovering over any metric name shows its explanation
steps: Each <td> containing a metric name in the modal table has a data-tooltip attribute with the explanation
Each metric name td has the has-tooltip CSS class applied
Hovering over 'Entropy' in the modal table shows the full entropy explanation
Hovering over 'Lyapunov Exp.' shows the Lyapunov exponent explanation
All 10 metrics in the modal table have tooltips
Tooltips are readable over the modal background and do not get clipped by the modal edges
The tooltip z-index is high enough to appear above the modal overlay

description: Add tooltips to the Phase Explorer metric checkboxes and the Rule Map axis dropdown options so users can understand metrics when selecting them
steps: Each checkbox label in the Phase Explorer has a data-tooltip and has-tooltip class for its metric
Hovering over a checkbox label (e.g., 'Lyapunov') shows the Lyapunov explanation
All 6 Phase Explorer metric checkboxes have tooltips
The Rule Map X-axis and Y-axis dropdown labels/selects have tooltips explaining 'Choose a metric for this axis'
When hovering over the dropdown option labels, the selected metric's tooltip is visible (via a small info icon or help text near each dropdown that shows the current metric's description)
Tooltips do not interfere with checkbox toggling or dropdown selection
